label: ai-insight-auth
info:
AI Insight — Token Verify (NF-6)

Shared Keycloak access-token verifier, reached via link call from every
AI Insight HTTP endpoint. Closes the header-trust model: identity (roles,
subject) derives exclusively from a cryptographically verified JWT;
client-supplied x-user-roles headers are never trusted.

Pipeline: prep (Bearer extract, issuer check, JWKS cache) ->
[http request GET JWKS on cache miss] -> jose.jwtVerify (signature, exp,
issuer, optional audience) -> msg.identity { sub, username, client,
roles: realm_access.roles }.

Failure semantics: 401 + WWW-Authenticate for missing/malformed/expired/
invalid tokens; 503 when the JWKS endpoint is unreachable (fail closed).
Authorization decisions (403) stay in the per-endpoint policy nodes.

Environment:
  AI_INSIGHT_AUTH__MODE        enforce (default) | off (dev-only legacy headers)
  AI_INSIGHT_AUTH__ISSUER      default: FACIS_KEYCLOAK_URL
  AI_INSIGHT_AUTH__JWKS_URL    default: <issuer>/protocol/openid-connect/certs
  AI_INSIGHT_AUTH__AUDIENCE    optional aud check
  AI_INSIGHT_AUTH__JWKS_TTL_SECONDS  JWKS cache TTL (default 300)

name: prep + JWKS cache check
verify JWT (jose)
